pages.text: Nothing about a Bog Toad is wasted. The legs are meat, and meat can be cooked.$(br2)$(item)Raw Toad Legs$() restore little. Cooked in a furnace, smoker or over a campfire they become $(item)Cooked Toad Legs$(), a meal more filling than steak.

pages.title: Cooked Toad Leg
pages.text: A smoker or a campfire does the same job.

pages.title: Toad Stew
pages.text: A heavy stew, and only one bowl per stack.

pages.title: Stew's Blessings
pages.text: Toad Stew is always edible, even on a full stomach. It grants:$(br2)$(li)Regeneration for 15 seconds$(li)Resistance for 1 minute$(li)$(thing)Ogre's Bane$() for 5 minutes$(br2)Ogre's Bane makes your blows land 15% harder against ogres of every kind.
